pr_body:
For services using delegation, `systemd-journald` wouldn't be able to filter the subcgroups logs as it would read the extended attributes from the subcgroup itself, instead of the unit's cgroup (see #26024).

Fixes it by introducing a function to get the service's cgroup path from a given cgroup path. 

This change has been tested with `Delegate=yes` and the unit's attributes are properly used by the subcgroup, also I've used the same test cases are `cg_path_get_unit` to ensure the behaviour is similar.

Fixes #26024

I misunderstood escaping, I think it's fixed now. To summarise changes:
- `cg_path_get_unit_path()` will get the unit's path from a valid cgroup path.
- From a given cgroup path, once we have skipped the slices, ensure with have a valid unit name before the next `/` (if any). If so, return the path until the next `/`, otherwise return an error.
- Added more unit tests, especially for escaped paths. 

Once we skip slices in a path, should we expect nested `systemd` constructs? For example: `/system.slice/user.scope/test.service` or something similar? I assumed we should not, but I'm not 100%. I added tests with nested constructs, even if it's not supposed to happen, we know at least how `cg_path_get_unit_path()` would behave.

issue_context.title: Per-unit log filtering won't work with delegated units
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

origin/main

### Used distribution

none

### Linux kernel version used

none

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

None

### Component

systemd-journald

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

Log messages from all processes within a delegated service properly honor `LogFilterPatterns=`.

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

```
foo.service
`- deleg-cgroup
   ` PID
```
The process PID is under a delegatee's created cgroup, the code in `client_context_read_cgroup/client_context_read_log_filter_patterns` would look at `foo.service/deleg-cgroup` xattr, however, it was only (rightfully) configured on the `foo.service`.

The code should look for xattr's at the unit's level cgroup (cf. `cg_path_get_unit`).

### Steps to reproduce the problem

I noticed it while I was rebasing #24961 onto current `main`, it's theoretical but it may happen unless I've overlooked something (tm).

Cc: @qdeslandes
